# Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust & NDR Schools, Kiratpur

> **Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust** (श्री नारायण दास रस्तोगी चैरिटेबल ट्रस्ट) is a public charitable trust registered in Delhi on 09 August 1991. It runs the NDR schools in **Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur, District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh – 246731**, founded on **28 March 1990** by **Late Shri R. B. Rastogi** and family in memory of Late Lala Narain Dass Rastogi. The school opened on 18 July 1990 with 9 LKG pupils and a ₹25 monthly fee; in 2026 it has **348 students, 15 teachers and 2 support staff**.
> 1. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Saraswati Shishu Mandir** — pre-primary & primary (LKG–Class V), co-educational; permanent recognition 1996–97 (Basic Shiksha Parishad). UDISE+ `09030704709`
> 2. **Sri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir J.H. School** — girls, Classes VI–VIII; recognised 2002 (Basic Shiksha Parishad). UDISE+ `09030704734`
> 3. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Inter College** — girls, Classes IX–XII (UP Board); High School recognition 2004, Intermediate (XI–XII) 2006. UDISE+ `09030704754`

## Key facts
- Principal: **Shri Devendra Singh** (from 1 August 2026). Vice Principal: Shri Vinish Kumar.
- Founder: Late Shri R. B. Rastogi (1932–2003).
- Board of Trustees: Shri Subhash Rastogi (Chairman & Managing Trustee; joined the Board in 2025 and heads the revival and growth of the school and the Trust), Shri Ravinder Kumar Rastogi, Shri Vipul Kumar Rastogi, Smt. Kanika Rastogi (Trustee – Creative Direction & Development).
- UP Board ‘A’ grade for Intermediate results in 2010 and 2011. Peak enrolment 591 (2014).
- PAN: `AAATN1994L`
- Income-tax registration (12AB-equivalent), **provisional**, Section 332(8), Income-tax Act 2025: `AAATN1994LE20261`, tax years 2026–27 to 2028–29.
- Donor deduction approval (80G-equivalent), **provisional**, Section 354(4), Income-tax Act 2025: `AAATN1994LF20261`, tax years 2026–27 to 2028–29.
- MCA CSR-1: `CSR00117504` (SRN `AC5909859`).
- NGO Darpan: `DL/2026/1118189`.
- Donations: accepted only in the Trust's own account at Ujjivan Small Finance Bank, Noida Branch. Donors complete a KYC step at https://narain-dass-rastogi-trust.vercel.app/support#donate before payment details are shown, so the Trust can file Form 10BD and issue the 80G receipt (Form 10BE). Cash above ₹2,000 is not eligible for 80G.
- Trust office: 1/5430, Basti Harphool Singh, Sadar Bazar, Delhi – 110006. Email: naraindassrastogicharitabletrust@outlook.com
- School: Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur – 246731, District Bijnor, U.P. Email: ndrgicktp@gmail.com
